_meta.repo_home: Lives in this repo at frontend/src/lib/tokens.json because this UI is its only consumer today — promote to a shared design repo when a second consumer appears (Sofia's placement call, card t_aeed4097).
_meta.code_truth: tokens.json is the code-facing source of truth; Penpot mirrors it
_meta.naming: Colour token names are the brand kit's published names (Penpot shared library revn 46: 8 brand group + 6 hud-*) so the file and the kit speak one language. Values are unchanged from the previous file except color.primary (signal-blue) and color.secondary (beacon), both per Naura's decision on card t_ec093f43. Where a kept value still differs from the kit's hex under the same name, that token's description says so — value alignment is the flagged follow-up (flag F2).

signal-blue.description: Main brand accent — from Penpot brand palette (was color.primary #6366F1; value set by Naura's call, t_ec093f43. 5.02:1 on white, AA pass)

beacon.description: Secondary accent (was color.secondary #8B5CF6 → beacon, Naura's binding call on t_ec093f43 — kit name and value agree)

paper.description: Default surface (was surface.default) — exact match to brand kit `paper`

cloud.description: Elevated surface (was surface.elevated) — exact match to brand kit `cloud`

hud-navy.description: Overlay surface (was surface.overlay) — kept #1E293B for contrast on overlay content; kit `#050B1A` is too dark

ink.description: Primary text (was text.primary) — exact match to brand kit `ink`

steel.description: Secondary text (was text.secondary) — exact match to brand kit `steel`

hud-steel.description: Disabled text (was text.disabled) — kept #94A3B8 for neutral disabled appearance; kit `#6E93B4` is too saturated

hud-green.description: Success (was status.success) — kept #22C55E for WCAG AA contrast on white; kit `#4ADE80` fails AA at small text sizes

hud-gold.description: Warning (was status.warning) — kept #F59E0B for WCAG AA contrast on white; kit `#FFC14D` fails AA at small text sizes

hud-red.description: Error (was status.error) — kept #EF4444 for WCAG AA contrast on white; kit `#FF6B6B` fails AA at small text sizes

sky.description: Info (was status.info) — kept #3B82F6 for WCAG AA contrast on white; kit `#6EC8FF` fails AA at small text sizes
